Beta 49
New · Drag Wallpaper Engine wallpaper folders straight in: video and web wallpapers are imported with the title, entry page and properties from project.json, WebM is converted to MP4 as usual, and scene wallpapers that contain a video have it extracted. You can also drop the whole 431960 folder to import everything at once. No command-line tool needed. · Global shortcuts can be changed: Settings → General → Shortcuts, click a shortcut to record a new one.
Fixes · Settings that web wallpapers save for themselves are no longer lost on relaunch, and wallpapers no longer share them. · Turning on timed rotation didn’t actually start it until you changed another setting; now it starts right away. · Fill mode, volume and “Play sound” in the inspector lagged one step behind, so the switch looked reversed; changes now apply immediately. · Turning off mouse parallax left the wallpaper shifted instead of re-centring it. · Adjusting a web wallpaper’s properties could undo a favourite or frame-rate cap you had just set. · Day/night switching now shows the real next sunrise or sunset under “Next change”, and tells you when no day or night wallpaper is chosen. · In timed rotation, ticking wallpapers or changing the order no longer switches immediately; after a manual “Next”, the countdown restarts from that moment.
Improvements · Global shortcuts now default to ⌃⌥⌘P / ⌃⌥⌘→ / ⌃⌥⌘M / ⌃⌥⌘C. The old ⌥⌘ ones took keystrokes away from Finder (Copy as Pathname, path bar), Xcode and browsers. Record ⌥⌘ again in Settings if you prefer it. · Leftover files that belong to no wallpaper are cleaned up at launch (wallpaper folders go to the Trash; caches like thumbnails are deleted). · Release notes are now available in English.

Beta 49
新功能 · Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸文件夹直接拖进来就能用：视频、网页壁纸按 project.json 的标题、入口和属性导入，WebM 照常转成 MP4；场景（Scene）壁纸里带视频的会把视频抽出来。也可以把整个 431960 文件夹拖进来一次导入全部。不再需要命令行工具。 · 全局快捷键可以自己改：设置 → 通用 → 快捷键，点组合键重新录。
修复 · 网页壁纸里存的设置（比如壁纸自己记住的样式）重启后不再丢，壁纸之间也不再互相串。 · 刚打开「定时轮播」时其实不转，要再改一处设置才开始；现在打开就开始。 · 检查器里改填充方式、音量、「播放声音」慢一拍，开关看起来像接反了；现在立刻生效。 · 关掉「鼠标视差」后壁纸停在偏移的位置，不回正。 · 调网页壁纸的属性时，会把刚才的收藏、帧率上限改动冲掉。 · 「日夜切换」的「下次切换」显示真正会换的日出 / 日落时间；白天和夜晚都没选壁纸时会提示。 · 定时轮播时勾选参与的壁纸、改顺序不再立刻换一张；手动「下一张」后倒计时从这一刻重新算。
改进 · 全局快捷键默认换成 ⌃⌥⌘P / ⌃⌥⌘→ / ⌃⌥⌘M / ⌃⌥⌘C。原来的 ⌥⌘ 会抢走访达（拷贝路径名、路径栏）、Xcode 和浏览器的快捷键。想用回 ⌥⌘ 可以在设置里自己录。 · 启动时清掉不属于任何壁纸的残留文件（壁纸文件夹移到废纸篓，缩略图之类的缓存直接删）。 · 更新说明有了英文版。
